name: Servo Robot
summary: Four-servo robot (torso, head, two arms) on a NodeMCU. It hosts its own control page, so a phone can drive it over WiFi with no PC involved.
hardware: NodeMCU ESP8266 (powered over its own micro-USB)
Left arm servo — signal to D5 (GPIO14)
Right arm servo — signal to D6 (GPIO12)
4x MG90S metal-gear micro servos (4.8-6V, ~700mA stall each)
5V 2A adapter for the servos only, GND shared with the NodeMCU
1000uF capacitor across the 5V rail to absorb start-up current bursts
notes: Runs on the robot itself, not this PC, so the hub has nothing to launch — use the links. Copy robot/secrets.example.h to robot/secrets.h for WiFi; without it the robot starts its own hotspot (RobotBot / robot1234). Never power the servos from the NodeMCU.
